pages.text: Breakable artifacts can be dismantled into $(item)Artifact Fragments$(). Four fragments make an $(item)Artifact Template$(), which can be transmuted into a random artifact.
pages.title: Artifact Creation
Artifact Fragments
pages.text: A breakable artifact yields 3 fragments. Compatible artifacts from the Artifacts mod can also be dismantled.

pages.title: Artifact Template
pages.text: Combine 4 Artifact Fragments to make a template.

pages.title: Transmutation
pages.text: Use the template in the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l) to create a random artifact. The possible results include Raidborn artifacts and compatible artifacts from the Artifacts mod.
